title: Popescu preparation core
statement: Let k be a field of characteristic p>0, A and Λ commutative k-algebras, A finitely presented over k and Λ Noetherian. For an algebra map h define H(h) to be the radical of the extended singular ideal. Let α:A→Λ be a k-algebra map and q a prime of Λ. A polynomial-base datum consists of an integer m, R=k[X_1,…,X_m], compatible k-algebra structures R→Λ and R→C on a commutative ring C finitely presented over R, and maps β:A→C over k and γ:C→Λ over R, such that γβ=α and H(α)⊆H(γ). A parameter datum consists of an integer r≥1 and π_0,…,π_(r-1) in R. Each π_i maps into q. For each i let B_i be R/(π_j^8:j<i) and T_i be Λ/(image(π_j)^8:j<i). Multiplication by π_i and by π_i² have identical kernels on both B_i and T_i. Each image of π_i in C is strictly standard over R. Define J=(π_i^8) in R, J_C=JC, J_Λ=JΛ, Q=R_(q∩R), L=Λ_q, JQ=J·Q and JL=J·L. Use the induced algebra map Q→L. An auxiliary thickening datum consists of n>0 with m_L^n⊆JL, ideals I⊆Q and K⊆L with I⊆JQ, K⊆JL and IL⊆K, a commutative Q-algebra D, a compatible Q/I-algebra structure on D, and algebra maps f:Q⊗_R C→D and g:D→L/K over Q. Require D to be essentially smooth over Q/I and gf to equal the canonical tensor map induced by Q→L/K and C→Λ→L/K. Assume Λ is geometrically regular over k and q is minimal over H(α). Then polynomial-base, parameter and auxiliary thickening data as described above exist. The carriers C and D may be represented in the universe max(u,v), where k:Type u and A:Type v; Λ may be in an independent universe. No quotient dimension, minimal-prime alternative, or final factorization over R/J is asserted here.

proof.text: Let H be the extended singular ideal. Ideal.radical_minimalPrimes removes the radical in popescuIdeal, so q is minimal over H. The minimal-prime localization radical theorem identifies sqrt(HΛ_q) with qΛ_q=m_L. Noetherianity makes m_L finitely generated; the radical-power lemma gives N₀ with m_L^N₀⊆HΛ_q. Use N=N₀+1>0 and monotonicity of ideal powers to obtain the positive input bound.

Apply the global standardizer construction with this N and bound. Retain all polynomial-base and parameter witnesses, n,I₀,K and the concrete coefficient ring E=D′[t]. Its maps a:C→E and b:E→L/K are over R and compose to the canonical map.

Put I=I₀Q. The supplied containments give I⊆JQ, K⊆JL and IL⊆K. Use quotient maps to give Q/I an R/I₀-algebra structure and L/K a Q/I-algebra structure. Check the R/I₀,R,Q scalar towers on representatives using the localization scalar tower.

Construct D=(Q/I)⊗_(R/I₀)E, which has carrier in Type(max(u,v)), its compatible Q- and Q/I-algebra structures, and the right tensor inclusion j:E→D. Essential-smooth base change proves D essentially smooth over Q/I.

Define f:Q⊗_R C→D by tensor lifting Q→D and ja. Extend b to an R/I₀-algebra map by surjectivity R→R/I₀. Tensor lifting Q/I→L/K and b gives g:D→L/K, restricted to Q. To check gf equals the canonical tensor map, use Q-algebra tensor extensionality: on 1⊗y, f yields 1⊗a(y), g yields b(a(y)), which is the canonical image by the supplied equation ba. These are explicit maps, not witnesses supplied by the construction lemma.

theorem exists_popescu_char_p_preparation_core
    {k : Type u} {A : Type v} {Λ : Type w}
    [Field k] [CommRing A] [CommRing Λ] [Algebra k A] [Algebra k Λ]
    [FinitePresentation k A] [IsNoetherianRing Λ]
    (p : ℕ) [CharP k p] (hp : 0 < p)
    (α : A →ₐ[k] Λ) (q : PrimeSpectrum Λ)
    (hreg : IsGeometricallyRegular k Λ)
    (hminimal : q.asIdeal ∈ (popescuIdeal α).minimalPrimes) :
    ∃ (m : ℕ) (_ : Algebra (MvPolynomial (Fin m) k) Λ)
      (_ : IsScalarTower k (MvPolynomial (Fin m) k) Λ)
      (C : Type (max u v)) (_ : CommRing C) (_ : Algebra k C)
      (_ : Algebra (MvPolynomial (Fin m) k) C)
      (_ : IsScalarTower k (MvPolynomial (Fin m) k) C)
      (_ : FinitePresentation (MvPolynomial (Fin m) k) C)
      (β : A →ₐ[k] C) (γ : C →ₐ[MvPolynomial (Fin m) k] Λ),
      (γ.restrictScalars k).comp β = α ∧ popescuIdeal α ≤ popescuIdeal γ ∧
      ∃ (r : ℕ) (π : Fin r → MvPolynomial (Fin m) k),
        1 ≤ r ∧
        (∀ i, algebraMap (MvPolynomial (Fin m) k) Λ (π i) ∈ q.asIdeal) ∧
        (∀ (i : Fin r)
          (x : MvPolynomial (Fin m) k ⧸ Ideal.span
            {y | ∃ j : Fin r, j.val < i.val ∧ y = π j ^ 8}),
          π i • x = 0 ↔ π i ^ 2 • x = 0) ∧
        (∀ (i : Fin r)
          (x : Λ ⧸ Ideal.span
            {y | ∃ j : Fin r, j.val < i.val ∧
              y = algebraMap (MvPolynomial (Fin m) k) Λ (π j) ^ 8}),
          π i • x = 0 ↔ π i ^ 2 • x = 0) ∧
        (∀ i, IsStrictlyStandardElement
          (R := MvPolynomial (Fin m) k) (algebraMap (MvPolynomial (Fin m) k) C (π i))) ∧
    let R := MvPolynomial (Fin m) k
    let J := Ideal.span (Set.range (fun i : Fin r ↦ π i ^ 8))
    let Q := Localization.AtPrime (q.asIdeal.under R)
    let L := Localization.AtPrime q.asIdeal
    letI := Localization.AtPrime.algebraOfLiesOver (q.asIdeal.under R) q.asIdeal
    let JQ := J.map (algebraMap R Q)
    let JL := (J.map (algebraMap R Λ)).map (algebraMap Λ L)
    ∃ (n : ℕ), 0 < n ∧ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal L ^ n ≤ JL ∧
      ∃ (I : Ideal Q) (K : Ideal L),
        I ≤ JQ ∧ K ≤ JL ∧ I.map (algebraMap Q L) ≤ K ∧
        ∃ (D : Type (max u v)) (_ : CommRing D) (_ : Algebra Q D)
          (_ : Algebra (Q ⧸ I) D) (_ : IsScalarTower Q (Q ⧸ I) D),
          EssentiallySmooth (Q ⧸ I) D ∧
          ∃ (f : Q ⊗[R] C →ₐ[Q] D) (g : D →ₐ[Q] L ⧸ K),
            g.comp f = Algebra.TensorProduct.lift (Algebra.ofId Q (L ⧸ K))
              ((Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ R K).comp
                ((IsScalarTower.toAlgHom R Λ L).comp γ))
              (fun _ _ ↦ Commute.all _ _)
